detail: Stationery items follow the general 30 day return policy described in the return and refund document. Stationery is not part of the Grocery category and items are not typically marked Final Sale, so most Stationery purchases remain eligible for a standard return.

Stationery items are not covered under the Electronics warranty program described in the warranty document, since that program applies specifically to the Electronics category. Any Stationery quality issue is instead handled through the standard return and refund process rather than a warranty claim.
Stationery orders above a set quantity threshold may qualify for a bulk discount; support can confirm current thresholds and pricing on request, since they are adjusted periodically.
